map.呼吸衰竭血气鉴别器 使用指南: Blood Gas Respiratory Failure Discriminator User Guide
map.呼吸衰竭血气鉴别器依据动脉血气 PaO2、PaCO2 判别 I 型（低氧性）与: The Blood Gas Respiratory Failure Discriminator uses the arterial PaO2 and PaCO2 to distinguish type I (hypoxaemic) from type II (hypercapnic) respiratory failure, and computes the oxygenation index and the A-a gradient.
map.Ⅰ型/Ⅱ型呼衰: Type I / Type II respiratory failure
map.：FiO₂ 0.21：PAO₂=0.21×713=149.7；A-a=149.7: With FiO₂ 0.21: PAO₂=0.21×713=149.7; A-a=149.7−60/0.8−50=24.7 > 15.1 → type II respiratory failure with an increased gradient.
map.：PaO₂<60 而 PaCO₂ 正常→Ⅰ型呼衰，提高吸氧浓度。: PaO₂<60 with a normal PaCO₂ → type I respiratory failure, so raise the oxygen concentration.
map.痰液性状颜色临床意义查询器: Sputum Character and Colour Clinical Lookup
map.PaO₂<60 即可诊断；伴 PaCO₂>50 为Ⅱ型(通气不足)。: PaO₂<60 is enough for a diagnosis; with PaCO₂>50 it is type II (hypoventilation).
map.PAO₂=FiO₂×(760−47)−PaCO₂/0.8；梯度随年龄增大。: PAO₂=FiO₂×(760−47)−PaCO₂/0.8; the gradient rises with age.
